setup_image_pretraining_task: setup a Fairseq ImagePretrainingTask from an ImagePretrainingConfig dataclass instance
load_image_dataset: load an image dataset for a given split with augmentation and normalization transforms
create_image_pretraining_config: create an ImagePretrainingConfig with data path, input size, and normalization parameters
review_image_augmentation_pipeline: review the ColorJitter, RandomHorizontalFlip, and RandomResizedCrop transform pipeline in load_dataset
register_image_pretraining_task: register the image_pretraining task with Fairseq using the register_task decorator
